title: Decision: draft-mahy-oob-aad-00 is track-only for mimid (a sketch)
description:
Assay mimid-1wgh.44.15 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-oob-aad-00.txt (224 lines, read whole; sha256 in specs/PROVENANCE).

What it is: an outline for out-of-band AAD: a new oob_aad list of SafeAADItems added to PrivateContentAAD and FramedContentTBS (§3), so both sides bind values that are never sent (signalled by a GroupContext extension and two component types). It says itself it cannot be a 'safe' extension because the MLS stack must change (§3). No codepoints, IANA section empty, Security TODO, terms in §2 named but not defined.

Possible MIMI use (not in the draft): binding hub-known state such as the room URI or the participant list hash into every message signature without sending it. mimid has no need today.

RECOMMEND: track only; revisit if it gets a full revision. The earlier keyword hit (mimid-e05c, user discovery) is unrelated. No conflict beads.
